'''VerveGen''' was a former subsidiary of [[Synchet Industries]] before being bought by undercover agents of the [[Eagle]]. As of [[3643 BBY]], its membership included [[Raythen Predot]], [[Aphel Jaarn]] and [[Chorto Rinn]]. All were killed when its offices were infiltrated by [[Cipher Nine]] and [[Kaliyo Djannis]].<ref name="TOR" />
